identificationModule.briefTitle: Denosumab Fracture Intervention Randomized Placebo Controlled Trial in Japanese Patients With Osteoporosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled Phase 3 Study Evaluating Efficacy and Safety of Denosumab in Japanese Osteoporotic Subjects With Prevalent Fragility Vertebral Fracture(s)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluate the efficacy and safety of denosumab in the treatment of involutional (postmenopausal and senile) osteoporotic subjects with prevalent fragility vertebral fracture(s)

armGroups.description: Denosumab (subcutaneously - every 6 months) + daily calcium and vitamin D supplements for 24 months, followed by a 12-month period of denosumab (subcutaneously - every 6 months).
Placebo (subcutaneously every 6 months) + daily calcium and vitamin D supplements for 24 months, followed by a 12-month period of denosumab (subcutaneously - every 6 months).
Alendronate sodium hydrate oral tablets weekly + daily calcium and vitamin D supplements for 24 months (open label reference arm).

interventions.name: Denosumab
interventions.description: Subcutaneous injection every 6 months for 24 months, followed by a 12-month period of denosumab (subcutaneously - every six months).

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Subcutaneous injection every 6 months for 24 months, followed by a 12-month period of denosumab (subcutaneously - every six months).

interventions.name: Alendronate sodium hydrate
interventions.description: Oral tablet once a week for 24 months

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of New or Worsening Vertebral Fractures in Osteoporotic Subjects Treated With Denosumab Compared to Placebo

secondaryOutcomes.description: The results are expressed as percentage by Kaplan-Meier estimate the percentage of participants with non-vertebral fractures

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Hip Fractures in Osteoporotic Participants Treated With Denosumab Compared to Treatment With Placebo.
secondaryOutcomes.description: The results are expressed as a percentage by Kaplan-Meier estimate.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Involutional (postmenopausal and senile) osteoporosis with prevalent fragility vertebral fractures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any underlying condition,(other than BMD) that might have resulted in abnormal bone metabolism
